description: Saves the invitee's answers to questions the host asks (`questions` on the booking, those not yet in `answers`). Questions are answered when booking, in create_booking's `answers`. This is for an answer the invitee wants to add or change afterwards: don't ask them again after booking. A new answer to a question replaces the old one. Returns the booking.

id.description: the question's `id`, from `questions` on get_public_profile or on the booking
id.title: maxLength(24)

value.description: the answer: words for a text question, one of its `options` for a choice, a phone number with its country code for a phone question
value.title: maxLength(500)

id.description: the booking id from create_booking, or its manageUrl

token.description: the token from create_booking, or the manageUrl

name: answer_booking
title: Answer a booking's questions (invitee)
